attempts.text:
Car1 does five round trips from Panchakanya shelter, two adults are deferred, and car2 stays idle, for a total cost of 402.

**Assumptions**
- Panchakanya shelter and Tadi hospital are the only evacuation points. Dhunche temple is not designated, so nobody is dropped there.
- Usable roads: Panchakanya–Dhunche 12, Dhunche–Thakre 10, Panchakanya–Syaphru 34, Syaphru–Myagang 6, Myagang–Trishuli 12, Syaphru–Gajuri 9 and Panchakanya–Tadi 42. Thakre's other road (via Jwalamukhi), Likhu and Syaphru–Likhu exist but are not used.
- Blocked roads: Gajuri–Myagang, Trishuli–Gajuri, Likhu–Myagang and Panchakanya–Thakre.

**Why car2 stays parked:** Tadi hospital's only road leads to Panchakanya (42 minutes). Any trip car2 made would be the same trip car1 could make, plus 42 extra minutes.

**Car1's five trips** (each starts and ends at Panchakanya):

| Trip | Route | Picks up | Minutes | Penalty avoided |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Dhunche | 1 child, 3 adults | 24 | 120 |
| 2 | Dhunche, Thakre | 3 adults at Thakre, 1 adult at Dhunche | 44 | 80 |
| 3 | Syaphru, Myagang, Trishuli | 4 elderly | 104 | 200 |
| 4 | Syaphru, Myagang, Trishuli | 3 elderly, plus 1 adult at Myagang on the way back | 104 | 170 |
| 5 | Syaphru, Gajuri | 2 children and 1 adult at Gajuri, 1 adult at Syaphru | 86 | 160 |

**Deferred:** 2 adults at Syaphru farm (penalty 40). A separate trip for them would cost 68 minutes, which is more than the 40 penalty.
